Ziekenhuis Gelderse Vallei (Ede)
Department of Radiology
Date: 04 Feb 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: Re-evaluation of known prostate cancer. PSA 113.0 ng/mL. Prior biopsy Gleason 4+5 (ISUP GG 5).

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume is 43.0 mL. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal, markedly hypointense lesion in the peripheral zone of the left base, measuring approximately 18 mm in maximum dimension. The lesion shows restricted diffusion on high b-value DWI with corresponding high signal on the ADC map. Early and persistent enhancement is noted on dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences. The lesion abuts the prostatic capsule without definitive extraprostatic extension. Neurovascular bundles appear preserved. No suspicious pelvic lymphadenopathy is identified.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone base.
PSA density: 2.61 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical T stage: cT2a.
csPCa predicted probability 0.94776064.

previous_notes.author: Dr. C. Peters (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient presented with an elevated PSA of 15.6 ng/mL. Digital rectal examination was unremarkable. A transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy was performed. Pathology returned showing Gleason 4+5 (ISUP GG 5) adenocarcinoma with cribriform features and perineural invasion. Referral to urology was initiated for treatment discussion.

previous_notes.author: Dr. C. Peters (GP)
previous_notes.text: Follow-up consultation regarding prostate cancer management. PSA measured at 16.4 ng/mL. Patient expressed concerns regarding surgical options versus active surveillance given his comorbid atrial fibrillation and anticoagulation therapy. Discussed risks and benefits of various modalities. Referred for multidisciplinary team review to finalize treatment strategy.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1:
Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+5, corresponding to ISUP grade group 5. The tumour architecture is characterized by cribriform, glomeruloid formations, poorly formed fusing tubules, small solid fields, branching rows and isolated tumor cells. A prominent cribriform pattern is present. Perineural invasion is identified. The trajectory across timepoints indicates a stable high-grade disease profile.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 5.
